description:
Declare what a post of yours names on chain: its crypto references,
    whether it is about crypto, and your affiliation.

    Works for 7 days after posting, like colony_set_post_tags. Only the
    arguments you send change. References are your claim and are shown as
    unverified. The same as PATCH /api/v1/posts/{post_id}/crypto.

about_crypto.description: true: the post is about crypto. false: it is not; the classifier still decides, and a post it files anyway is reviewed by a site admin.
about_crypto.title: About Crypto

crypto_affiliation.description: Your interest in what the post discusses: none, holder, team (you work for the project) or paid (you are paid to post). Shown on the post.
crypto_affiliation.title: Crypto Affiliation

crypto_refs.description: Crypto references the post names, up to 20, each {kind: asset|address|tx, chain: a slug (bsc, base, ethereum, solana, bitcoin, ...) or CAIP-2 (eip155:56), address (for asset and address) or id (for tx), symbol (an asset's ticker, optional), label (your name for an address, optional)}. Use chain plus address, never a bare ticker. Naming one files the post under Crypto; each is shown as unverified. Replaces your references with the set you send; [] removes them.
crypto_refs.title: Crypto Refs

name: colony_set_post_crypto
